notes.title: Update 1.1.9 - Brazilian and European Portuguese Language Support
notes.content:
After a little translation work, I have now made the game's UI available in Portuguese.
The translations are suitable for speakers of both European and Brazilian Portuguese.

In addition, I have fixed a small bug in the 'Let's Study!' zone which affected button functionality.

Let's Learn Japanese!

Cyril.

notes.title: Update 1.1.7 - Russian Language Support, Kana View and Bug Fix
notes.content:
I'm pleased to announce the following updates:

Russian is now available as a UI language.

All vocabulary can be viewed in either roman alphabet or kana (hiragana and katakana as necessary).

A bug has been fixed in the Prize Room, which prevented players from opening the Ninja Run game reliably.

Enjoy learning Japanese!

Dr. Cyril Splutterworth.
